ابتسروا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَسَرُوا (ibtasarū) /ib.ta.sa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# اُبْتُسِرُوا (ubtusirū) /ub.tu.si.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# اِبْتَسِرُوا (ibtasirū) /ib.ta.si.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
